question: Which of the following ports is located along the east coast of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Paradip**__.

• **Paradip:**

 
 
• Paradip Port is a major seaport located in the state of Odisha on the eastern coast of India.
 
• It is situated at the confluence of the Mahanadi River and the Bay of Bengal.
